crossRefs.note: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding. I have removed…
My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered…
I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh…
But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring…
A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will…
“Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and…
but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break…
He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
translations.bsb: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!
translations.kjv: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
translations.asv: How are the things of Esau searched! how are his hidden treasures sought out!
